test_title: PYST 32 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option:

The professor's remarks were so ________ that even seasoned scholars found them difficult to decipher.
solution:
The correct answer is '**enigmatic**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The word "**enigmatic**" means puzzling or mysterious, which fits the context of the professor's remarks being difficult to decipher. 
 
• Options like "**translucent**" and "**verbose**" do not align with the idea of being hard to understand or mysterious.
